title: Celestial Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle, Moon and Star Ornaments, Crescent Moon Laser Cut Files for Cricut, Silhouette (svg, dxf, png)
description:
Moons, stars and winter skies for the tree: six original celestial Christmas ornament cut files.

The set has a crescent moon cradling a star with tiny stars cut out of it, a classic bauble with a crescent moon and a scatter of stars, a star-studded wreath with an eight-point star at its heart, a moon phases ornament with stars above and below, an eight-point starburst, and a round frame with a crescent moon, hanging stars and three pines on a snowy hill. Solid shapes keep every design easy to read, even small on the tree.

Each design is a single-layer, single-path cut file with a hanging loop built in. Stars and moons are attached, so nothing falls out.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 6 designs: Crescent Moon & Stars Ornament, Star & Moon Bauble Ornament, Celestial Wreath Ornament, Moon Phases Ornament, Starburst Ornament, Moon Over Pines Ornament
• SVG: Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, Illustrator
• DXF: Silhouette Studio Basic Edition, laser software (inches)
• PNG: transparent background, 1800 px on the longest side (6 in at 300 DPI)

SIZE
Default size is about 6 in on the longest side. The thinnest parts are about 0.08 in at 6 in, so we recommend 4 in or larger for cardstock, felt and vinyl and 4.5 in or larger for laser-cut wood or acrylic.

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on up to 500 finished physical items per design. Please don't share or resell the digital files.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. Files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP.

Listing photos include digital mockups; you receive the digital files shown.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand for clean cuts.
